experiment_status.motivation: Exploratory bimonthly-frequency follow-up motivated by the V41 quarterly-rebalance result.
experiment_status.interpretation: This reuses the same fixed 2024-01-02 through 2026-06-30 historical window and frozen V34 factor memberships; it is not an independent or unseen holdout.

source_strategy.portfolio_rule: Use the already-frozen V34 membership audit: rank the four banks by signal-date close factor value descending, stock-code tie break, and target equal 50% weights in the Top2.

rebalance_rule: Starting in January 2024, update the target only on the first shared V34 monthly signal date in each odd-numbered calendar month. Read the frozen V34 Top2 membership for that signal and execute at the next trading session open. On every even-numbered month signal, place no rebalance orders and carry forward the prior odd-month target. The first January 2024 signal initializes the portfolio at equal Top2 weights. No frequency or rule changes after results.

comparison.monthly_control: Replay all 30 frozen V34 monthly Top2 memberships over the same window using the same V11 corrected ledger.

ledger: Use V11/analysis.py unchanged: next-session open; shared cash; 100-share lots; 1% participation cap; commission and minimum commission, transfer fee and sell stamp duty; adverse slippage; one-price limit blocks; corporate-action adjusted shares; odd-lot full-exit handling. Mark at 2026-06-30 close without forced liquidation.

resource_gate.requirement: Run immediately only if the host CPU utilization snapshot is below 50%; otherwise do not wait for capacity.
resource_gate.enforcement: Set a 180 GiB RLIMIT_AS address-space hard cap for the V47 process and record peak RSS.
